text:
natalie: Quick check — onboarding zeta-13b weights. HF origin -> our S3 mirror worked but tokenizer outputs different token counts for some prompts. Also noticed presign TTL on the manifest is 1h but CI expects 12h. Anyone seen this combo?

kevin: re: tokenizer — which prompt? is it padding vs BOS behavior? we saw similar with tokenizer v2.1 where leading whitespace changes counts.

natalie: example prompt: `\"\nWhat is Redwood Inference?\"` vs "What is Redwood Inference?" yields +2 tokens on our local run. Using hf-tokenizers 0.13.3.

sam: that sounds like special leading-space tokenization. try running `python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('org/zeta-13b'); print(t.encode(' What is Redwood Inference?'))"` — compare outputs.

natalie: ran that, matches the +2 tokens locally. But serving side (dedicated runtime) uses our tokenizer shim that strips leading whitespace for safety. So mismatch between local HF artifact and runtime.

arjun: ok — two followups: 1) we should record tokenizer version in manifest (tokenizer_version: 0.13.3) and 2) make runtime respect explicit `preserve_whitespace` flag in model config.

maria: on presign TTL: CI job `weights-fetch` expects presigned manifest + shards to be valid for 6h during cross-region copy. Why is manifest TTL 1h? that might be coming from the HF->S3 mirror lambda default.

ml-ingest-bot: mirror-job-1789 completed. origin: hf://org/zeta-13b, dest: s3://redwood-artifacts/zeta-13b/2026-03-18, manifest: s3://redwood-artifacts/zeta-13b/2026-03-18/manifest.json, presign_ttl: 3600s

kevin: migration plan: bump mirror lambda to set presign_ttl=43200 for manifests, keep shard TTL shorter (1h) to limit long-lived shard links. CI should fetch manifest then spawn parallel signed GETs for shards.

natalie: can we change TTL per-file-type? manifest=12h, shards=1h sounds fine. Who owns mirror lambda config?

arjun: infra-ops owns it. @deploy-bot can you open a quick patch?

deploy-bot: created PR #4534 in infra/mirror with change: default_presign_ttl_manifest=43200. Link: https://git.redwood/infr/mirror/pull/4534 :white_check_mark:

sam: for tokenizer fix — propose adding `tokenizer_preserve_space: true` into `model-config.yaml` and add a validation rule in onboarding CI that compares token counts for a set of golden prompts (small set ~10). If mismatch > 2 tokens for any prompt, fail and require explicit flag.

maria: I'll add the golden prompts to `tests/onboard/golden_prompts.json` and update CI in `platform/ci/weights-fetch` to fetch manifest first and validate presign TTL header.

natalie: thanks. one last thing — checksum mismatch on shard `p-0003` during mirror dry-run. `sha256` on HF side: `e3b0c442...` but S3 shows `e3b0c442...-gz` (looks gzipped). Did mirror gzip shards in transit?

arjun: mirror lambda compresses shards for storage optimization if size > 200MB. We should annotate `manifest.json` with `content_encoding: gzip` when that happens. PR incoming to add that metadata.

kevin: summary action items: 
- infra: PR #4534 set manifest TTL=12h (deploy pending)
- infra: annotate content_encoding for compressed shards in manifest (arjun)
- devex: add `tokenizer_preserve_space` and golden prompts in onboarding tests (sam/maria)
- runtime: support flag fallback to preserve whitespace (kevin)

natalie: perfect. pinging owners for reviews. I'll retest once PRs merge. :thumbsup:
